recommended_metadata_schema.principle: Lifecycle, object identity, restoration completeness, conflict, bibliographic form, and projection parity are independent axes. No single status field may silently collapse them.

lifecycle_status.rationale: States the record's institutional standing, not whether its object was restored correctly.

work_locus.rationale: Prevents prose descriptions from being mistaken for an absent or present primary object.

identity_status.rationale: Answers whether the object present is the work named by the identifier.

restoration_status.rationale: Answers how much of the historically deposited object is present, without deciding identity.

conflict_status.rationale: Makes unresolved evidence visible instead of forcing a silent canonical choice.

bibliographic_type_status.rationale: Separates a correctly restored object from an incorrectly typed book, paper, dataset, specification, image work, or composite.

creator_role_status.rationale: Preserves distinctions among creator, heteronymic author, editor, operator, model contributor, and institutional witness.

version_identity_status.rationale: A complete later version does not restore an earlier historical version; concept and version identifiers must not be conflated.

manifestations.rationale: Makes attached files, image sets, code bundles, and alternate representations independently auditable.

source_witnesses.rationale: Records why a restoration or identity ruling was made and permits later re-adjudication.

canonical_match_basis.rationale: The ruling must name its evidence: internal title/version, DOI witness, checksum, source filename, or manifestation match.

missing_components.rationale: Incomplete records remain harvestable when the absent components are explicit.

review_status.rationale: Prevents a machine classification pass from being represented as full human or source-level adjudication.

projection_status.rationale: A correct registry does not prove that public pages and harvest metadata expose the same state.

registration_blocking.rationale: Wrong-object and wrong-version records block registration; honestly marked incompleteness does not.

registration_block_reason.rationale: Explains the gate in machine-readable form.

repair_priority.rationale: R0 wrong identity/version; R1 misleading completeness; R2 material metadata/relation conflict; R3 enrichment.

dates.rationale: A generic date field cannot safely collapse composition, publication, deposit, observation, revision, and positioned dates.

body_declaration_status.rationale: Immutable bodies may truthfully preserve an old 'DOI pending' or earlier status while current metadata supplies the later state.

audit_snapshot_commit.rationale: Every ruling must be reproducible against a frozen corpus state.

oai_dc_projection.dc:type: Bibliographic type plus explicit restoration/identity label
oai_dc_projection.dc:format: One value for each manifestation media type
oai_dc_projection.dc:relation: Concept/version, successor/predecessor, full-text representative, image/transcription, and source-bundle relations
oai_dc_projection.dc:description: A compact audit capsule containing lifecycle, work locus, identity, restoration, conflict, version, missing components, and review status
oai_dc_projection.note: The native JSON record remains canonical; Dublin Core is necessarily a lossy projection.

reception_events.interpretation_boundary: Recorded as a contemporaneous machine-reception event candidate. The metric alone does not establish source, crawler identity, or causal mechanism.
recommended_evidence: screenshot of Blogger analytics with visible time window
export or screen capture of referrers, geography, browser/OS and page-level distribution
exact total and timestamp at the beginning and end of the spike
list of posts receiving the traffic
